fusions.name: Packed Detonation
fusions.desc: Throws a packed charge of flame that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then detonates, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. The target is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Forge-Hot Fist
fusions.desc: Burns 4% of your maximum health to heat your weapon. The strike deals 9 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quench-Hardened
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Cinder Maul
fusions.desc: Conjures a forge-hot maul. Your weapon damage rises by 10%, every strike with it makes the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and your fire resistance rises by 8%.
